records.jp: せっかくだから……かき氷、食べていこっか？
records.en_original: Hey, why don't we have some shaved ice while we're here?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, why don't we have some shaved ice while we're here?
records.en: Hey, why don't we have some shaved ice while we're here?

records.jp: いいね。やっぱり暑いビーチには冷たいものだよ。<CR>ここ、学校だけど
records.en_original: Ooh, that sounds great! The perfect beach snack. Even though this is a school...
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, that sounds great! The perfect beach snack. Even though this is a school...
records.en: Ooh, that sounds great! The perfect beach snack. Even though<CR>this is a school...

records.jp: ふふ。<CR>お祭りとかもそうだけど、夏といえばかき氷だよね
records.en_original: Hehe. Shaved ice always makes me think of summer.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. Shaved ice always makes me think of summer.
records.en: Hehe.<CR>Shaved ice always makes me think of summer.

records.jp: 風物詩ってヤツだねえ。<CR>食べた後、頭キーン！　ってなるのもセットで
records.en_original: Yeah, totally. I always manage to get a massive brain freeze though.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, totally. I always manage to get a massive brain freeze though.
records.en: It's one of those seasonal traditions.<CR>And of course you have to get brain freeze afterward.

records.jp: あれ、わたし苦手……。<CR>食べると絶対なっちゃうんだよね……
records.en_original: Oh, I hate those. I don't think I've ever eaten shaved ice without getting one...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I hate those. I don't think I've ever eaten shaved ice without getting one...
records.en: Oh, I hate those. I don't think<CR>I've ever eaten shaved ice without getting one...

records.jp: でも、食べるのはやめないんだ
records.en_original: But you still eat it anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: But you still eat it anyway?
records.en: But you still eat it anyway?

records.jp: だって食べたいんだもん……。<CR>頭きーんの辛さより勝っちゃうの
records.en_original: But it tastes so good... I think it's worth the pain.
records.en_auxiliary: But it tastes so good... I think it's worth the pain.
records.en: Because I want to eat it...<CR>That desire wins over the pain of brain freeze.

records.jp: 何というか……こころらしいや
records.en_original: That's so... Kokoro of you.
records.en_auxiliary: That's so... Kokoro of you.
records.en: That's so... Kokoro of you.

records.jp: ゆっくり食べるといいらしい、って聞いたことあるよ。<CR>急に冷たいモノ食べるからなっちゃうんだって
records.en_original: I've heard it doesn't hurt if you eat it slowly. So if you don't go too fast you won't get one.
records.en_auxiliary: I've heard it doesn't hurt if you eat it slowly. So if you don't go too fast you won't get one.
records.en: I've heard it doesn't hurt if you eat it slowly.<CR>So if you don't go too fast you won't get one.

records.jp: うーん……でもゆっくり食べてたら溶けちゃうよね
records.en_original: Hmm... But if I eat it slowly it would melt.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... But if I eat it slowly it would melt.
records.en: Hmm... But if I eat it slowly it would melt.

records.jp: 確かに……。<CR>溶けるくらいなら頭キーンを受け入れた方がいいね
records.en_original: That's true... I guess I would rather get a brain freeze than let it melt.
records.en_auxiliary: That's true... I guess I would rather get a brain freeze than let it melt.
records.en: That's true...<CR>I guess I would rather get a brain freeze than let it melt.

records.jp: 海の家って他にも食べ物のメニュー色々あるよねえ
records.en_original: Beachside cafes really have all kinds of food, don't they.
records.en_auxiliary: Beachside cafes really have all kinds of food, don't they.
records.en: Beach huts really have all kinds of food, don't they.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんは好きなメニューってある？
records.en_original: Do you have a favorite, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have a favorite, Ao?
records.en: Do you have a favorite, Ao-chan?

records.jp: やっぱ海の家といったらラーメンでしょ！
records.en_original: Ramen, obviously!
records.en_auxiliary: Ramen, obviously!
records.en: Ramen, obviously!

records.jp: 海の家のラーメンって、そんなにおいしいの？
records.en_original: Is the ramen at beachside cafes that good?
records.en_auxiliary: Is the ramen at beachside cafes that good?
records.en: Is the ramen at beach huts that good?

records.jp: ううん。全然
records.en_original: Nope. Not at all.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope. Not at all.
records.en: Nope. Not at all.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 場所にもよるとは思うけど、私が行ったところは<CR>どこも美味しくなかったよ
records.en_original: I'm sure it depends on the place, but everywhere I've been has had terrible ramen.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure it depends on the place, but everywhere I've been has had terrible ramen.
records.en: I'm sure it depends on the place, but everywhere I've been<CR>served pretty terrible ramen.

records.jp: じゃあ、どうしてそんなに好きなの？
records.en_original: Then why do you like it so much?
records.en_auxiliary: Then why do you like it so much?
records.en: Then why do you like it so much?

records.jp: 何て言うのかな……。<CR>あの安っぽさが逆に良いっていうか
records.en_original: It's hard to explain... The crappiness makes it taste that much better!
records.en_auxiliary: It's hard to explain... The crappiness makes it taste that much better!
records.en: How do I put it...?<CR>That cheap quality is actually part of what makes it good.

records.jp: 海に来たー！　って感じになるからかな？
records.en_original: For me, you can't go to the beach and not have some crappy ramen.
records.en_auxiliary: For me, you can't go to the beach and not have some crappy ramen.
records.en: Maybe because it makes me feel like, “I came to the beach!”

records.jp: うーん……。<CR>わたしはせっかくならおいしいご飯が食べたいな
records.en_original: Hm... I think I'd rather eat something tasty.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm... I think I'd rather eat something tasty.
records.en: Hm...<CR>I think I'd rather eat something tasty.

records.jp: まあ、それも一理ある……
records.en_original: Well, I can't argue with that.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I can't argue with that.
records.en: Well, I can't argue with that.

records.jp: 定番だけど焼きそばかな？<CR>うちで出る焼きそばよりも美味しく感じるよね
records.en_original: It's a little basic, but I love yakisoba. They always taste better on the beach than at home.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a little basic, but I love yakisoba. They always taste better on the beach than at home.
records.en: It's a classic, but maybe yakisoba?<CR>It always tastes better than the kind you eat at home.

records.jp: 鉄板とフライパンの差かな……？<CR>鉄板の方が火が通りやすいから
records.en_original: Maybe it's because they make it on a griddle? Those get hotter than frying pans.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it's because they make it on a griddle? Those get hotter than frying pans.
records.en: Maybe it's because they make it on a griddle?<CR>Those get hotter than frying pans.

records.jp: あー、そういうことなのかな。<CR>確かに、アツアツの鉄板で作ってるイメージあるかも
records.en_original: Ah, that could be. Now that you mention it, they do all use those griddles.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, that could be. Now that you mention it, they do all use those griddles.
records.en: Ah, maybe that's why.<CR>I do picture it being cooked on a piping-hot griddle.

records.jp: あの鉄板からソースのいいにおいが<CR>してくるんだよね……
records.en_original: It always smells so good when they make it like that...
records.en_auxiliary: It always smells so good when they make it like that...
records.en: It always smells so good when they<CR>make it like that...

records.jp: ついつい引き寄せられちゃうよね……
records.en_original: That's how they lure you in.
records.en_auxiliary: That's how they lure you in.
records.en: That's how they lure you in.

records.jp: でも、海の家って働いてる方は大変そうだよね
records.en_original: But working at a beachside cafe must be tough.
records.en_auxiliary: But working at a beachside cafe must be tough.
records.en: But working at a beach hut must be tough.

records.jp: そうだね。暑い中働かなくちゃいけないし、<CR>接客とかも大変そう……
records.en_original: Yeah. Working in the heat all day and having to worry about customers...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Working in the heat all day and having to worry about customers...
records.en: Yes. They have to work in the heat,<CR>and serving customers looks difficult too...

records.jp: こころが店員なら大繁盛間違いなしなのにねえ
records.en_original: I'm sure you'd be a big hit if you worked at one!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure you'd be a big hit if you worked at one!
records.en: I'm sure you'd be a big hit if you worked at one!

records.jp: どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: こころの水着目当てにお客さんが押し寄せて来るよ、<CR>きっと
records.en_original: People would come from far and wide just to get a peek of you in your swimsuit.
records.en_auxiliary: People would come from far and wide just to get a peek of you in your swimsuit.
records.en: Customers would surely flood in<CR>just to see you in a swimsuit, Kokoro.

records.jp: いやいや、それはないよ
records.en_original: No way! That would never happen.
records.en_auxiliary: No way! That would never happen.
records.en: No way! That would never happen.

records.jp: またまたー
records.en_original: Oh, don't be so modest.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, don't be so modest.
records.en: Oh, don't be so modest.

records.jp: 水着で料理したら危ないし……<CR>海の家で働くなら水着はないよ。ちゃんと服着なきゃ
records.en_original: Cooking in only a swimsuit is dangerous! I'd be sure to wear the provided uniform.
records.en_auxiliary: Cooking in only a swimsuit is dangerous! I'd be sure to wear the provided uniform.
records.en: Cooking in a swimsuit would be dangerous...<CR>If I worked at a beach hut, I'd wear proper clothes.

records.jp: ああ、そっち……
records.en_original: That's what you're worried about...?
records.en_auxiliary: That's what you're worried about...?
records.en: That's what you're worried about...?

records.jp: でも、こころと一緒ならやってみてもいいかも。<CR>大変そうだけど、楽しそう
records.en_original: But I wouldn't mind working at one with you! The work might be tough, but I think it'd be fun!
records.en_auxiliary: But I wouldn't mind working at one with you! The work might be tough, but I think it'd be fun!
records.en: But I wouldn't mind working at one with you! The work might be<CR>tough, but I think it'd be fun!

records.jp: んー……わたしも、愛央ちゃんと一緒なら、アリかな
records.en_original: Hmm... I'd be up for it too, if it was with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I'd be up for it too, if it was with you.
records.en: Hmm... I'd be up for it too if it were with you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 任せといて。こころがナンパされそうになったら<CR>すかさず助けに入るよ
records.en_original: Don't worry. I'll protect you from all the creepy boys who try to hit on you!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. I'll protect you from all the creepy boys who try to hit on you!
records.en: Leave it to me. If someone tries to hit on you, Kokoro,<CR>I'll immediately step in and save you.

records.jp: ふふ、頼もしいね
records.en_original: Hehe, my hero.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, my hero.
records.en: Hehe, my hero.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
